description: This file defines a PHP class 'PayGradeConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It configures menu behavior for the 'Pay Grade' section within the OrangeHRM admin module, specifically overriding the screen to 'viewPayGrades'.

classes.name: PayGradeConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu behavior for the Pay Grade section in the OrangeHRM admin module by overriding the relevant screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewPayGrades' using a helper method, and returns null.
